narrative.details: <The fact that you only found only one body is a hopeful sign. Perhaps the High Elf that Trevan and Hadrec described is still alive somewhere deeper inside the nearby fortress?>
narrative.objectives: Investigate Fenris Keep to the north and attempt to locate the missing member of the Earthen Ring party.
narrative.offerRewardText: You are one of the Forsaken, yes? Can you help free me?Time is short for me, I am afraid. Please hurry!
